visualContent.description: A Cartesian coordinate system is drawn with green x and y axes. A continuous green curve is drawn on this plane. The curve starts in the upper left quadrant, descends to cross the negative x-axis, then continues to a local minimum below the x-axis. From there, it ascends to cross the y-axis and then the positive x-axis, reaching a local maximum above the x-axis. It then descends briefly, crosses the positive x-axis again, and finally ascends continuously towards the upper right. Two small arrows are drawn on the curve: one points downwards near the local minimum, and another points upwards near the far right ascending portion of the curve.
